Target Material.cell: returned asteroid sample; carbonaceous chondrite; eucrite; terrestrial rock — Ryugu (A0106, A0106-A0107, C0108), Tagish Lake, Tarda, Ivuna, Colony, Bouvante, Bereba and terrestrial RMs

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Digestion aliquot — Ryugu "aliquots of <25 mg were analyzed with ~40 to 70 ng Zr"; Tagish Lake 30 mg, Tarda 90 mg, Ivuna 40 and 44 mg "from a larger homogenized powder (550 mg)"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Homogenised powder — Ivuna aliquots taken "from a larger homogenized powder (550 mg)"

Digestion Acid(s).cell: hotplate HF–HNO3: concentrated HF–HNO3; HNO3–HCl: HNO3–HCl; HNO3–H2O2 dissolution: HNO3–H2O2; high-PT HF–HNO3: concentrated HF–HNO3; Parr bomb: concentrated HF–HNO3; Ivuna high-PT: concentrated HF–HNO3, then concentrated HCl

Digestion Duration.cell: hotplate HF–HNO3: 3–7 days; HNO3–HCl: 12 h; high-PT HF–HNO3: about a week; Ivuna high-PT: 3 days, then 2 days; other: N

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 0.5 M HNO3–0.005 M HF at 30 ppb Zr — samples and standards
